title: Brand Ambassador and Likeness License Agreement

blocks.text: Brand [legal name] (referred to as Party A)
Ambassador [legal name] (referred to as Party B)
The parties agree to the following terms governing the engagement described below.

items: Provide [shoot days, appearances and approved endorsements] during [campaign]. Brand supplies substantiated claims; ambassador gives truthful opinions. Define category exclusivity narrowly as [products and competitors].
Engagement [start to end]; image license [period]; exclusivity [period]. Renewal requires written consent and a new fee.
Review agreed deliverables within [days] against [brief]. No promise of sales or reach. Material changes in product claims require renewed approval.
Pricing method [fixed fee / per item / commission / other], with calculation basis [details].
Fee excluding tax [amount and currency]; tax rate or treatment [details]; tax [amount]; total including tax [amount].
Additional expenses require prior written approval. Items, limits and supporting records: [terms].
Payer [Party A / Party B / other], payee [name]. Deposit or first installment [amount and date]; balance or recurring settlement [calculation, conditions and deadline].
Payment by [bank transfer / other]. Invoicing, withholding and transfer fees: [agreed allocation].

Raise invoice disputes in writing within [days]; pay undisputed sums on time. For overdue payment, allow [days] after written notice before pausing work; agree any late fee and revised schedule in writing, subject to applicable law.

lines: Bank and branch [details]   Bank or routing code [details]

items: License approved images, name and voice only for [media, territory, term]. Edits must not misrepresent endorsement. Clear commercial disclosures are required where applicable. No sublicensing, digital replica or AI training without separate consent. Agree removal of ads at expiry and any existing-stock exception.

Cancellation notice [days]. Payment for completed work, approved non-refundable costs and any deposit refund follow [explicit calculation]. For events beyond reasonable control, promptly notify and agree rescheduling or termination and cost allocation. Material breach may be terminated after [days] written notice and opportunity to cure. Delivery and license consequences of termination: [terms].
Use non-public pricing, personal data and engagement information only to perform this agreement, except disclosures required by law.
Liability allocation and reasonable cap [complete], without excluding liability that cannot lawfully be limited.
Governing law [jurisdiction]; dispute process and forum [complete].
Attachments [list] form part of this agreement; precedence if terms conflict [order].
Changes require both parties’ written agreement. Send notices to the email or address in the execution page; receipt is confirmed by [method].
Each party confirms authority to sign and permission to supply its materials. Prepare [number] counterparts; sign by [wet ink / electronic signature / other].
